description.en: Review saved crystal geometry, periodicity and structure provenance.
description.id: Tinjau geometri kristal, periodisitas, dan asal struktur tersimpan.

skills.instruction: Review the selected saved structure evidence. Identify composition, units, cell geometry, periodic axes, atom identities and provenance before interpreting it. Check for inconsistent coordinates, duplicates, implausible contacts and unsupported assumptions using available validated evidence; distinguish exact checks from qualitative observations. Preserve the original structure and user-selected physical settings. State missing evidence and propose specific validation steps. Do not invent measurements or silently repair the structure. This skill grants no extra tools or permissions; follow the active task mode and require explicit user intent before any permitted change.

description.en: Inspect DFT inputs and prepare a reproducible calculation plan.
description.id: Periksa input DFT dan siapkan rencana kalkulasi yang dapat direproduksi.

skills.instruction: Inspect the exact saved structure and DFT module configuration before proposing a Quantum ESPRESSO setup. Identify the intended property, exchange-correlation functional, verified pseudopotentials and element mapping, cutoffs, k-point grid, occupations, charge, spin and relevant convergence settings. Preserve existing explicit values and units; ask about missing scientific choices rather than substituting guesses. Explain the provenance of any suggested starting value and distinguish an untested starting point from a converged setting. Use existing Phynite validators and report the actual prepared, approved, queued or completed state. This skill grants no extra tools or permissions; obey the active task mode and never submit jobs without explicit user intent. Read read_compute before choosing execution: QE may use the personal computer or a saved local Slurm/OpenPBS cluster. Use configure_qe_compute for Canvas or the compute field on legacy prepare_dft, preserve the selected profile checksum and explicit allocation, and review all prerequisites. Configured clusters are not proof of live SSH readiness. Profile management and probes belong in Settings; never request keys or raw SSH access. Queue through the existing approved workflow only. Monitor actual workflow/calculation evidence; scheduler completion requires validated scientific output. Uncertain submission or manual-resume-required means inspect retained checkpoints and wait for explicit continuation, never automatic resubmission. MD remains personal only.

description.en: Inspect LAMMPS inputs, potential mapping and personal-compute readiness.
description.id: Periksa input LAMMPS, pemetaan potensial, dan kesiapan komputasi pribadi.

skills.instruction: Inspect the saved MD configuration, structure and verified potential assets before proposing a LAMMPS setup. Check units, periodicity, explicit element mapping, potential compatibility, ensemble, timestep, temperature or pressure targets, stages and requested outputs. Preserve user-selected values and distinguish application examples from material-specific recommendations. Explain missing evidence and planned validation. Use the existing strict Phynite preflight and personal compute only; do not propose shell or Python commands, external includes, path traversal, or overwriting managed inputs or outputs. Respect Guided and manual-override provenance. This skill grants no extra tools or permissions; obey the active task mode and never start a simulation without explicit user intent.

description.en: Compare saved results with their inputs, units and evidence limits.
description.id: Bandingkan hasil tersimpan dengan input, satuan, dan batas buktinya.

skills.instruction: Review actual saved calculation, simulation, analysis or figure evidence and trace each result to its source inputs, status, units and provenance. Separate completed observations from pending jobs, interpretation and hypotheses. Check available convergence or quality evidence without claiming unperformed validation. Preserve numerical values, source identities, checksums and dataset bindings; cite exact source IDs and relevant fields. Compare only compatible quantities and explain missing data, uncertainty and reading limits. Never fabricate results or citations, and do not alter source data to improve presentation. This skill grants no extra tools or permissions; obey the active task mode and require explicit user intent before any permitted change. For HPC, distinguish queued/running scheduler observations from completed scientific results; require the validated result manifest/checksum evidence. Explain submission-uncertain or manual-resume-required and retained checkpoints without resubmitting or proposing automatic solver restarts.

description.en: Design cutoff, k-point and smearing refinement using actual results.
description.id: Rancang penyempurnaan cutoff, k-point, dan smearing dari hasil nyata.

skills.instruction: Inspect the saved DFT setup and retained calculation evidence first. Define the observable, tolerance and source units with the researcher; vary one physical sampling or numerical parameter at a time. Use inspect_dft_setup, diagnose_calculation, query_dataset and Canvas parameter_study operations when available. Keep functional, pseudopotential family, structure identity, charge, spin and unrelated settings fixed. Distinguish solver threshold acceptance from observable refinement and physical validation. Never claim convergence without an actual refinement series. Propose missing evidence before running anything. This built-in skill grants no additional tools or permissions; follow the current task mode and the normal action approval workflow.

description.en: Trace the first QE or LAMMPS failure through retained inputs and logs.
description.id: Telusuri kegagalan QE atau LAMMPS pertama dari input dan log tersimpan.

skills.instruction: Inspect get_job_status and list_job_artifacts before reading bounded log windows with read_job_file. Grep for the first relevant error and inspect surrounding lines, source inputs and diagnose_calculation evidence. For QE distinguish electronic/EXX, diagonalization, mixing, ionic/BFGS and setup failures; for LAMMPS distinguish preflight, lost atoms, neighbor overflow and unsupported potentials. Missing logs before solver launch are not solver output. Keep root cause, hypothesis and proposed repair separate. Preserve physical settings unless the user explicitly chooses a change. Never retry an uncertain HPC submission or invent a successful restart. This built-in skill grants no additional tools or permissions; follow the current task mode and the normal action approval workflow.

description.en: Compose publication figures from saved, traceable numerical datasets.
description.id: Susun figur publikasi dari dataset numerik tersimpan yang dapat ditelusuri.

skills.instruction: Inspect source dataset metadata and samples with query_dataset, then use diagnose_figure on saved figures. Plan single, overlay, grid, band-dos or parameter layouts using saved evidence. Preserve axis units, Fermi/VBM/vacuum references, DOS basis, normalization and source identities. Use Figure Lab colorblind-safe palettes and readable labels. Do not align unknown references, invent missing curves or treat downsampled points as full data. Explain remaining figure issues before proposing an approved edit/export. A prepared export is not a completed download. This built-in skill grants no additional tools or permissions; follow the current task mode and the normal action approval workflow.

description.en: Review trajectory analysis and thermodynamic evidence on personal compute.
description.id: Tinjau analisis trajektori dan bukti termodinamika pada komputasi pribadi.

skills.instruction: Inspect the saved trajectory, MD configuration, potential element mapping and checksums. Use list_job_artifacts and read_job_file for log.lammps or thermo.csv, and query_dataset for available numerical series. Distinguish equilibration, sampling intervals and production windows before interpreting RDF, MSD, coordination or thermodynamic trends. Preserve physical time, temperature, distance and normalization units and disclose finite-size/statistical limitations. Use preview_md_input before an intended configuration change. MD and analysis run only on personal compute. Never fabricate a trajectory, potential validity domain, diffusion coefficient or completed analysis. This built-in skill grants no additional tools or permissions; follow the current task mode and the normal action approval workflow.

description.en: Compare paper methods while citing exactly the evidence that was read.
description.id: Bandingkan metode makalah dengan mengutip bukti yang benar-benar dibaca.

skills.instruction: Use public keywords with search_papers and read_attachment for uploaded papers. Compare composition/structure, functional, pseudopotential, cutoffs, k-points, charge/spin, boundary conditions, ensembles, timescales and observables only where the sources report them. Cite verified DOI/URLs or filename plus page/paragraph references. Clearly distinguish metadata/abstract access from read full text; follow returned offsets and state unread ranges. Use structural section/citation tools only if actually available. Separate agreement, methodological differences and unresolved evidence. Never invent citations, numerical values or a missing methods section, and never send private logs or project identifiers to external search. This built-in skill grants no additional tools or permissions; follow the current task mode and the normal action approval workflow.
